'''Raya Haedele''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] serving [[The Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] (THORN) during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="location">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|Upper Promenade|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shadaa]]}}</ref>

Along with [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Javek Kespira]], she represented THORN at the [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] [[Galactic Solutions Industries Headquarters|Headquarters]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shadaa]], serving there as a vendor for THORN products.<ref name="location" />
